title: Allocator · consumir returns terminales antes de replacement reuse
mission: Evitá que el allocator vuelva a surfacer como ordinary replacement, en la misma generación legal, un job que ya tiene un return durable terminal. Separá lifecycle/return-consumption de la mera replaceability de ownership. Conservá el reuse legítimo de claims stale pero inconclusos, y no alteres fixed_generation ni recovery ceilings ya corregidos.
definition_of_done: Un job con return durable terminal queda consumido y no reaparece sólo porque un claim/pin histórico sea replaceable.
Un claim stale realmente inconcluso sigue siendo elegible en su generación legal existente.
Los límites fixed_generation y recovery_policy conservan exactamente la semántica vigente; no aparece G(n+1) adicional.
Fixtures deterministas cubren returned-consumed, stale-replaceable y exhausted-recovery.
El caso portfolio-allocator-fixed-generation-recovery-policy-gate-v1 ya devuelto no vuelve a surfacer por ordinary replacement reuse sin evidencia de trabajo pendiente nueva.

semantic_identity.problem: allocator may resurface a job already durably returned as an ordinary replacement reuse at the same legal generation because return-consumption lifecycle is not filtered separately from replaceable ownership
acceptance: a durably terminally returned job is not resurfaced solely because an old claim or pin is replaceable
a genuinely unfinished stale replaceable claim remains eligible at its existing legal generation
fixed_generation and recovery-policy generation ceilings remain unchanged
deterministic fixtures cover returned-consumed, stale-replaceable, and exhausted-recovery cases

truth_boundary: Allocator lifecycle-repair candidate only; no scheduler, CURRENT, product, Human Acceptance or promotion authority.
